name: debug
description: Marks every place in Claude Code's interface a mod can draw in: a red X and the site's name in front of what each draws, a markers pane, and /debug:probe, a pane that draws text, a Raster and an Image to show what the terminal supports.

markers.title: Debug: Render-site markers
markers.description: A red X and the site's name in front of what each render site draws, and the markers pane that opens when the session starts. true (default) / false

probe.title: Debug: Probe pane
probe.description: /debug:probe, a pane that draws text, a Raster and an Image. true (default) / false

pr_trace.title: Debug: PR trace pane
pr_trace.description: /debug:pr-trace, a pane that lists the statusline mod's PR fetches. true (default) / false

handoff_trace.title: Debug: Handoff trace pane
handoff_trace.description: /debug:handoff-trace, a pane that shows why the statusline mod's handoff ran or did not. true (default) / false
